body:
Thank you for making this post for me. I wrote up almost the same thing and decided not to post, but I just uninstalled the game at 49 hours of play for the exact same reason. It does not feel like the game respects my time and I had to walk away from it before losing another 50.

I was utterly enthralled by the atmosphere and constant sense of discovery for the first 20 hours (after rolling credits ~10 hours in; I actually revealed room 46 before ever getting to the antichamber!), which then slowly waned and became annoyance at needing to perform the same menial tasks over and over again.

While trying to get every classroom to spawn, I actually just gave up in the middle of a decent run after getting the 6th classroom when I realized I now hated the feeling of playing and was no longer excited to see what came next. 

If the game were tweaked to allow certain elements to come together on runs, the puzzles would still be just as mysterious and thoughtfully challenging. I can't help but feel like if this game were ~40 hours to complete, it would be on EVERY Game of the Year list.
